predictions.selection_reason: Flash security configuration parameter -> allowDomain API call -> controls which domains can communicate with Flash object
predictions.source_summary: trustedOrigins parameter from flashvars (LoaderInfo.parameters), which comes from JavaScript configuration via flashvars attribute in SWF embedding
predictions.sink_summary: flash.system.Security.allowDomain API call that configures cross-domain security policy for the Flash object
predictions.guard_summary: Type check (typeof flashvars.trustedOrigins === 'string') and presence check (flashvars.trustedOrigins) but no validation of domain values; JavaScript encodes values but Flash receives raw split array
predictions.risk_pattern: Flash security domain whitelist configured from untrusted flashvars parameter without validation of domain values, allowing potential cross-domain policy manipulation
predictions.context_summary: Constructor function configures Flash security policy based on JavaScript-provided trustedOrigins parameter to enable cross-domain communication when SWF is served from CDN
unresolved_facts: Whether JavaScript-side validation exists for trustedOrigins values
How allowScriptAccess parameter interacts with allowDomain configuration
Whether there are any server-side controls on flashvars values

retrieval_query.mechanism_summary: Flash security domain whitelist configured from untrusted flashvars parameter without validation of domain values
retrieval_query.missing_control: validation of domain values in allowDomain configuration
retrieval_query.impact: cross-domain policy manipulation, unauthorized domain access
